name: Sant Julià de Vilatorta (Spain)
description: Light blue field with the yellow fortified house of the arms with light blue door and windows at the centre, between the two white lions regardant of the arms.
history: The council opened the adoption file on 26 March 2014; the flag was approved on 12 January 2018 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya. It is based on the arms (approved 17 November 2014) and incorporates the yellow domus with blue doors and windows, representing the residence of the Bellpuig family, and the white lions regardant representing Vilalleons, on a light blue ground.

features.role: domus with light blue door and windows, 3/7 of the height, representing the residence of the Bellpuig
